description: §8.10 Tier 2 loop hoisting (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"): the loop's single keyed read REASSIGNS an existing binding — `row = ?{…}.get()` directly in the body, inside an `if`, and on a `let row` declared OUTSIDE the loop; unhandled and handled (`!{ _ :> not }`). The hoisted Map lookup assigns the binding. Pre-S455 the direct reassignment re-declared it (`const row = …` / `var row = …` beside `let row` — E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC / a load-time SyntaxError), and the one inside an `if` read `not` on success (the nested read was never rewritten). The hoisted loop body also lowered without the enclosing scope's declared names, so the outer-binding form could not be told from a fresh declaration.
rationale: §8.10: "A for-loop whose body contains a single keyed `?{}` read SHALL be rewritten to a single `WHERE IN (...)` pre-fetch plus per-iteration `Map` lookup." §8.10.3: "The rewritten loop is observationally equivalent to the un-rewritten loop" — the un-rewritten loop assigns the existing binding.
